setup.text: A builder imagines distant people creating indoor environments that control temperature, light, and moisture.

a1.text: A healer thinks of shelter during dangerous heat or cold.

a2.text: A farmer wonders how crops would grow without ordinary rain and pollinators.

b1.text: A child asks what happens if the controlling machinery stops.

b2.text: An elder says comfort is valuable but fragile when it depends on distant supplies.

c1.text: Villagers examine the ventilation of their own huts and the shade of trees.

c2.text: A builder admits that traditional designs can be improved without being dismissed.
